## Pull request overview

Aligns Console ViewConfigPanel with the `@objectstack/spec` RowHeight enum (5 values) and exposes an explicit `clickIntoRecordDetails` toggle so navigation behavior is configurable via the panel schema.

**Changes:**
- Extend `rowHeight` enums in Types + Zod validation from 3 → 5 values (`compact`, `short`, `medium`, `tall`, `extra_tall`).
- Update Console config schema/utilities to expose the full row-height set and add `clickIntoRecordDetails` switch in UserActions.
- Expand Console test coverage to assert the new toggle and row-height option completeness; update roadmap notes.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 7 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts | Expands `ListViewSchema.rowHeight` Zod enum to 5 values. |
| packages/types/src/objectql.ts | Expands TS `rowHeight` unions for `ObjectGridSchema` and `NamedListView` and updates docs. |
| apps/console/src/utils/view-config-utils.ts | Adds `short` + `extra_tall` to `ROW_HEIGHT_OPTIONS` with gap classes. |
| apps/console/src/utils/view-config-schema.tsx | Adds `clickIntoRecordDetails` switch to the UserActions section. |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/view-config-schema.test.tsx | Adds spec-alignment tests for row-height options and click-into-details field presence. |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/ViewConfigPanel.test.tsx | Updates row-height button assertions to include all 5 values. |
| ROADMAP.md | Documents completion notes for the spec alignment items. |
</details>

ObjectGridSchema.rowHeight is expanded to include 'short' and 'extra_tall', but the ObjectGrid implementation still hardcodes a 3-value rowHeight mode ('compact' | 'medium' | 'tall') and cycles/styles based on only those values (see packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx:129, 1031-1036, 804-808). With the new type, passing 'short'/'extra_tall' will either fail type-checking in strict builds or fall back to the 'medium' styling at runtime. Update the grid row-height logic/types to support all 5 enum values (or explicitly narrow ObjectGridSchema.rowHeight back to 3 values if the grid intentionally only supports those).

ListViewSchema.rowHeight enum is updated here, but ObjectGridSchema's Zod schema currently doesn't define rowHeight at all (packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts:110-140). Since ObjectGridSchema.rowHeight is now part of the TS interface, consider adding the same z.enum to ObjectGridSchema Zod too; otherwise runtime validation/safeParse will strip or reject the field, leaving types and runtime validation out of sync.
